set.approach: The wall is reached by the gravel road that follows the east side of the Dumoine River, beginning close to the Grande Chute bridge, or by water from the small boat launch at km 29. The route is on the left part of the wall, a vertical face beside a fine amphitheatre; the amphitheatre sits above a scree slope just right of an immense block with a cave beneath it.

review.notes: Route page (French) for location and anchor access; area page for access. Translated. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.

set.approach: The wall is reached by the gravel road that follows the east side of the Dumoine River, beginning close to the Grande Chute bridge, or by water from the small boat launch at km 29. The route starts just left of The Dumoine Dream, and the anchor is a tree.

review.notes: Route page (French) and area page. No descent or top access stated. Translated.

set.approach: The big slab is easy to spot on arriving by canoe from the river. A hiking trail marked with orange ribbons leaves from near the km 8.5 campsite; as it nears the cliff edge, leave it to reach the top of the upper wall, then go down to the top of the big slab by the south side or by rappel. The route is in the upper part of the slab and is only reachable by rappel from the top, a little north of the last anchor of Distanciation sociale.
set.descent_text: The route is reachable only by rappel from the top, and the anchor is a tree up there.

review.notes: Route page (French) for location and tree anchor; the two area pages for the trail and the descent to the slab top. Translated.

set.approach: A hiking trail marked with orange ribbons leaves from near the km 8.5 campsite; as it nears the cliff edge, leave it to arrive at the top of the upper wall. The route is the last line on the left of the upper wall that is safe to walk to before the wall joins the big slab.
set.descent_text: The anchor is a tree on top. To get down to the foot of the upper wall and the top of the big slab, go around the south side or rappel.

review.notes: Route page and area page (French). Translated.
